_README.description: Historical and upcoming earnings release dates with EPS and Revenue data for S&P 500 companies
_README.purpose: Track earnings announcements, compare actual vs estimated results, plan for market-moving events
_README.data_source: Finnhub Earnings Calendar API (non-GAAP EPS and Revenue)
_README.free_tier_limitation: 1 month of historical earnings and new updates

field_descriptions.epsActual: Actual non-GAAP earnings per share (null if not yet reported)
field_descriptions.epsEstimate: Estimated earnings per share from analyst consensus
field_descriptions.revenueActual: Actual revenue in dollars (null if not yet reported)
field_descriptions.revenueEstimate: Revenue estimate including Finnhub's proprietary estimates
field_descriptions.hour: Timing of announcement: bmo (before market open), amc (after market close), dmh (during market hours)

usage_examples.upcoming_earnings: Filter by date >= today to see upcoming earnings announcements
usage_examples.surprise_analysis: Compare epsActual vs epsEstimate to calculate earnings surprises
usage_examples.revenue_trends: Track revenueActual vs revenueEstimate across quarters
usage_examples.timing_patterns: Group by hour to see which companies report bmo vs amc
usage_examples.calendar_planning: Use date field to plan trading around earnings events

_README.update_frequency: Daily recommended to capture new earnings announcements and updated estimates
_README.sorting: Events sorted by date (most recent first)
_README.note_on_nulls: epsActual and revenueActual are null for future earnings (not yet reported)
